title: The best cleaning scheduling software for short-term rentals (2026)
summary: Six STR cleaning scheduling tools compared on auto-assignment, photo proof, cleaner payments, marketplaces and price, with a turnover checklist.
body_markdown:
**The best cleaning scheduling software for short-term rentals creates every turnover from your bookings, assigns it to a cleaner who's actually available, and tells you, with photos, when the property is ready. It also handles what happens when things change: a guest extends, a booking cancels, a cleaner calls in sick, or the clean finishes early and the next guest wants to check in. This guide compares six tools on that whole loop, not just the calendar.**


We make ProhostAI, which is one of the tools here. We've described each product the way its own customers would and said where a competitor is the better choice. Pricing was checked on vendor sites in November 2026; where a vendor doesn't publish a price, we say so.


## Key takeaways


- **Every tool on this list can create a cleaning from a checkout.** The differences are in assignment, proof, payment and what happens next.
- **Turno is the pick if you need to find cleaners.** Its marketplace is the main reason to choose it.
- **Breezeway and Operto Teams are for big field teams** with inspections, maintenance and inventory on top of cleaning.
- **ProhostAI is the pick if cleaning is one part of a bigger job.** Turnovers connect to guest messaging, so a clean that finishes early can become a paid early check-in, and a cleaner's damage report becomes a task.
- **Require photos.** Timestamped photos protect you, your cleaner and your next guest in any dispute.


## What good cleaning software does


1. **Schedules automatically** from your PMS or Airbnb calendar, including same-day turnovers, and updates when bookings change.
2. **Assigns the right cleaner** by property and availability, with backup when someone declines.
3. **Gives cleaners a simple app:** checklists, notes, photo requirements, issue reporting, in their language.
4. **Proves the work:** timestamped photos, start and finish times.
5. **Pays cleaners** per clean or by the hour, without spreadsheets.
6. **Closes the loop:** tells you, and when useful the guest, when the property is ready.

## 1. ProhostAI


**Best for:** hosts and property managers who want cleanings, guest messaging and team tasks to work together.


ProhostAI creates a turnover cleaning after each checkout and assigns it to a cleaner based on availability and property. Cleaners use native iOS and Android apps, in Spanish, French, Italian, Chinese, Japanese and more, with custom checklists per property (written by AI or by you), supply tracking, issue reporting with photos, and timestamped photo and video uploads. You can require photos before a clean can be completed, track time with geofenced check-in, and pay cleaners automatically after each clean, per clean or by the hour.


Because cleanings live next to guest messaging, the next step happens on its own. ProhostAI can message the arriving guest when the clean is done. A finished-early clean can become an[early check-in upsell](https://prohost.ai/features/upsells) . A cleaner's damage report becomes a[task](https://prohost.ai/features/tasks) with photos, and you can see guest ratings by cleaner.


- **Strengths:** cleaning, guest messaging, tasks and payments in one system; strong cleaner app; works with Airbnb directly or with Hostaway, Guesty, Hospitable, OwnerRez, Lodgify, Smoobu and Beds24.
- **Trade-offs:** no cleaner marketplace. If you need to hire cleaners in a new market, Turno is better for that step.
- **Pricing:** $15 per property per month on the all-in-one plan (minimum $30), with every module included; there's also a free plan. See[plans](https://prohost.ai/plans) .


More:[cleanings](https://prohost.ai/features/cleanings) .


## 2. Turno


**Best for:** hosts who need to find cleaners, or who want a dedicated cleaning tool with payments built in.


Turno (formerly TurnoverBnB) creates cleaning jobs from your Airbnb, Vrbo or PMS calendar, notifies your cleaners, gives them checklists, and collects photos and problem reports. It handles cleaner payments, and its marketplace lets you post jobs and find vetted cleaners in your area. It integrates with PMSs including Hostaway, OwnerRez, Hospitable and Hostfully.


- **Strengths:** the marketplace; simple, focused cleaning workflow; widely known by cleaners.
- **Trade-offs:** cleaning only. Guest messaging, maintenance from guest reports and reviews live elsewhere. Some reviewers mention payment processing fees.
- **Pricing:** a free tier for basic use, with paid plans priced per property. Check Turno's site for current rates.


How we compare:[ProhostAI vs Turno](https://prohost.ai/vs/turno) .


## 3. Breezeway


**Best for:** property managers with a large field team who need inspections, maintenance and inventory as well as cleaning.


Breezeway automates cleaner scheduling and payments and gives staff detailed mobile checklists with photos, plus inspections, maintenance work orders, inventory, property dashboards and owner reports. Guest messaging and AI are available as add-ons or on combined plans.


- **Strengths:** the deepest field operations on this list.
- **Trade-offs:** more than a small host needs; combined plans with guest messaging are quoted.
- **Pricing:** free for your first property; Host Essentials is listed from $19.99 per unit per month; higher tiers are quoted.


How we compare:[ProhostAI vs Breezeway](https://prohost.ai/vs/breezeway) .


## 4. Operto Teams


**Best for:** professional managers who want detailed scheduling rules across housekeeping and maintenance.


Operto Teams, formerly VRScheduler, generates cleaning and maintenance tasks from reservations using rules you configure, shows them on a drag-and-drop calendar, and gives staff checklists with photos. Guest messaging is a separate product, Operto Guest.


- **Strengths:** flexible rules, long track record with professional managers.
- **Trade-offs:** setup takes time; pricing isn't published.


## 5. Hospitable


**Best for:** small and mid-size hosts already using Hospitable as their PMS.


Hospitable creates cleaning tasks from check-ins, checkouts and mid-stay events and sends them to cleaners by email, SMS or calendar feed, with photos of finished work. It includes a cleaner marketplace and teammate payouts.


- **Strengths:** free Essentials plan; very simple.
- **Trade-offs:** calendar-driven; less control over assignment and proof than dedicated tools.


How we compare:[ProhostAI vs Hospitable AI](https://prohost.ai/vs/hospitable-ai) .


## 6. Your PMS's task manager (Hostaway, Guesty)


**Best for:** teams that want cleaning inside the system they already use for bookings.


Hostaway and Guesty both create cleaning tasks from reservations and give staff a mobile app for checklists and photos.


- **Strengths:** no extra tool; cleanings and reservations in one place.
- **Trade-offs:** fewer cleaner-specific features (marketplace, time tracking, autopay) than dedicated tools.


## How to choose


- **1–5 listings, one cleaner you trust:** your PMS's task manager or Hospitable's free plan is often enough.
- **You need to find cleaners:** Turno.
- **5–200 listings, guests message a lot:** ProhostAI, so cleanings, guest updates and tasks work together.
- **A dedicated operations team with inspections and maintenance staff:** Breezeway or Operto Teams.


## A turnover checklist that works with any tool


1. **Confirm the schedule the night before.** Most tools send reminders the day before and the day of.
2. **Require photos of the rooms guests notice:** beds, bathrooms, kitchen, entry.
3. **Report, don't fix and forget.** Every damage or low-supply note should create a task.
4. **Mark it ready, then tell the next guest.** If the clean finishes early, that's a chance to sell early check-in.
5. **Look at guest ratings by cleaner each month.** It's the fairest way to find coaching opportunities.


## Frequently asked questions


**What is the best cleaning scheduling app for Airbnb?**
Turno is the best-known, especially if you need to find cleaners. ProhostAI is the stronger choice if you want cleanings connected to guest messaging and tasks. Breezeway suits large teams with inspections and maintenance.


**Can cleanings be scheduled automatically from Airbnb bookings?**
Yes. All the tools here create a cleaning after each checkout from your Airbnb or PMS calendar and update it when bookings change.


**How do I pay my Airbnb cleaners automatically?**
ProhostAI pays cleaners automatically after each completed clean through its Stripe integration, per clean or by the hour. Turno, Breezeway and Hospitable also handle cleaner payments.


**Do my cleaners need to download an app?**
Usually yes, though some tools also send jobs by SMS or email. ProhostAI's cleaner app is available on iOS and Android in many languages.


**How much does cleaning scheduling software cost?**
Most tools charge per property per month. Turno and Hospitable have free tiers, Breezeway is free for one property, and ProhostAI includes cleanings in its $15 per property all-in-one plan and offers a free plan.
